memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "As soon as Joseph saw his brothers, he recognized them, but he pretended to be a stranger and spoke harshly to them. 'Where do you come from?' he asked. 'From the land of Canaan,' they replied, 'to buy food.' Although Joseph recognized his brothers, they did not recognize him. Then he remembered his dreams about them and said to them, 'You are spies! You have come to see where our land is unprotected.'" - Gen 42:7-9 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Joseph knows his brothers at once, but they have no idea who he is. Years have passed; the boy they sold is now a clean-shaven Egyptian ruler speaking through an interpreter. So Joseph, recognizing them, chooses to conceal himself and speaks harshly, accusing them of being spies.

Why would Joseph act this way rather than fall on their necks immediately? As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that Joseph is not seeking revenge but testing his brothers — probing to see whether they have changed, whether the men who so callously sold him have become different. His harshness is part of a wise, careful process aimed not at destroying them but, eventually, at healing and reconciliation. Beneath the stern exterior, as we will soon see, is a heart that still loves them.

There is something here that reflects how God sometimes deals with us. He may allow hard, testing circumstances — moments that feel harsh — not because He has abandoned us or seeks to harm us, but because He is working something deeper: bringing hidden things to the surface, testing and refining our hearts, drawing us toward repentance and restoration. What feels severe may be love at work.

If you are in a season that feels harsh and confusing, do not assume God has turned against you. Sometimes His sternest dealings hide His deepest love, and He is working toward a reconciliation and a good you cannot yet see.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Have I assumed God was against me when He was actually at work?
2. Can I trust that hard seasons may hide God's deeper purposes?
3. How does Joseph's hidden love reshape how I view difficult times?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, when life feels harsh and confusing, help me not to assume You have turned against me. Trust that Your sternest dealings can hide Your deepest love. Work Your good purposes in me. Amen.
